source: Native AWS CLI, real authorized account
scope: One owned PROVISIONED single-shard stream, custom bus/rule, source-conditioned EventBridge role with exact PutRecord stream permission, and exact-rule standard SQS DLQ. No warm commitment, existing policy changes or broad account/org permissions.

observations.default_partition_key: Each of eight observed default keys equals the admitted EventId followed by underscore and an opaque UUID.
observations.transformed_payload: Both targets received the projected case/target object, while the custom key was selected from the original event's omitted detail.key.

limitations: One account, Region and run; 105-second post-admission observation bound.
Default UUID suffix generation and stability across retries were not measured. The implementation uses retained delivery identity for stable routing.
No throttling, KMS errors, oversized key or cross-account deliveries were exercised by this native probe.
